The learning plan encompasses various elements such as curriculum design, content development, learing delivery mechanisms, logistical arrangements, and post-implementation evaluation. It takes into account the unique needs of the workforce and aligns learning objectives with the organization's goals and timeline.

The delivery plan sets out the key actions to help deliver the learning activities (administration and logistics). The development plan determines who is in charge of the development of what content.

To verify that all timelines, dependencies, and parties involved in the assessment, design and delivery of training are working toward the same outcome; to drive activities that enable impacted audiences to operate in a new environment.

A typical plan includes sections for:

  • Learning needs analysis
  • Learning curriculum design
  • Learning journey map
  • Learning materials
  • Overall agenda and course timing
  • Instructional presentation
  • Student handbooks
  • Class exercises (instructions and solutions)
  • Instructor notes and setup materials
  • Course evaluatio nforms
